# ToolbarWrapper — Cobalt source template

<!-- Generated by tools/content.mjs from MDX and source; do not edit. -->

A horizontal toolbar container with a `gray100` background, a `start` slot on the left and an `end` slot on the right, and an optional bottom divider. Use it to build list headers, filter bars, and date-navigation bars above content areas.

## Copy and adapt

This is editable source, not an installable library. Never install `@openpencil/cobalt-extensions` or import that package name. Official `@talkdesk/*` dependencies are separate.
